title: Cyclic completion decision tree
statement: Given an index $s\in\{0,1,2\}$ and a known sign $k$, define a decision tree that first queries the second cyclic coordinate. If its sign equals $k$, the tree returns $k$; otherwise it queries the third cyclic coordinate and returns the sign found there. The first cyclic coordinate is excluded from the available coordinates.
